database.maintenanceHint: The database may be locked during maintenance and Sakuio may be temporarily unresponsive.
database.dsnPlaceholder: Leave empty to colocate with the main database
database.dsnHint: Connection string of the running metrics database; the type is detected automatically. SQLite: ./data/metrics.db; MySQL: mysql://user:password@host:3306/metrics; PostgreSQL: host=localhost user=metrics password=secret dbname=metrics port=5432 sslmode=disable. Leave empty to colocate with the main database.
database.mainConfigHint: Saving starts a main-database switch task: the connection is tested, all data is copied to the new database and verified table by table, then the server restarts automatically. Any failure keeps the current database in use. The SAKUIO_DATABASE_DSN environment variable takes precedence.
database.metricsConfigHint: Switches immediately without a restart and syncs history from the old database in the background; use the migration form below to import from another database.
database.mainSwitchStarted: Main database switch started; the server will restart automatically after verification
database.metricsSwitched: Metrics database switched; history is syncing in the background
database.taskConflict: Another database task is running; try again later
database.bucketHint: Global retention for 1-minute, 5-minute and 1-hour buckets. Daily buckets follow each metric's retention days; precise samples are kept in memory for 10 minutes only, and expired data is deleted by the hourly cleanup task.
database.retentionHint: Set the bucket retention days per metric; 0 disables persistence for that metric.
database.migrationHint: Migrates historical data from a source metrics database (the main database by default, or the previously used one) into the running target database, with re-aggregation into buckets. After changing the metrics DSN, run the migration to split from or merge into the main database.
database.sourceDsnPlaceholder: Source DSN (optional, defaults to the main database)
database.restartRequired: Pool limit saved; restart the service to apply

fieldHelp.name: Display name of the node, used in the admin panel and public dashboards. Can be changed anytime.
fieldHelp.group: Type and press Enter to add a group; multiple groups are allowed. Unknown groups are created automatically. Groups are used for filtering and organizing nodes.
fieldHelp.privateRemark: Private note visible to admins only; never shown to visitors or on public themes.
fieldHelp.price: Use -1 for free (shows a "Free" badge); empty or 0 means unset; other values render as currency + price.
fieldHelp.bandwidth: Node bandwidth config. Default unit Mbps; Kbps / Gbps / Tbps available. 0 means unset.
fieldHelp.billingCycle:
Preset cycles (calendar renewal): values matching a preset plan renew on the calendar. Common values: 30 (monthly), 92 (quarterly), 183 (semi-annual), 365 (yearly), 730 (biennial). Example: 30 — renewed on Mar 15, new expiry is Apr 15.
Custom days: other values (e.g. 7, 45, 100) renew by exact days. Example: 45 — renewed on Mar 15, new expiry is Apr 29.
One-time: -1 means one-time payment, never auto-renewed.
fieldHelp.autoRenewal: If the server is expired and currently online, the expiry date is automatically pushed by exactly one billing cycle: preset values (30/92/183/365/730) renew on the calendar, other values by exact days. One-time (-1) never renews.
fieldHelp.trafficThreshold: When the ledger usage (computed by stat mode) reaches this threshold, a notification fires at 80% (reminder) and 100% (alert). Units: KB / MB / GB / TB. 0 disables.
fieldHelp.trafficReset: Follow billing cycle: reset at each cycle end (one-time plans never reset); Monthly on the 1st: zeroed at midnight on the 1st of each month; No auto reset: manual reset only.
fieldHelp.reportInterval: Realtime collection and report interval in milliseconds (default 1000). Applies immediately to online nodes and on next connect otherwise.
